threads.body: `pull_request` is currently unscoped, so this workflow will run for PRs targeting any branch. If the intent is to match the documented/shared-workflow example (and the push trigger) and only run on PRs into `main`, add a branch filter under `pull_request`.

replies.body: This is intentional: the organization-wide zizmor rollout policy requires zizmor to run on pull requests targeting every branch. The push trigger remains limited to main.
